Meta’s Muse AI agent has well surpassed a whopping 10 million downloads despite two months of security and privacy problems. In this solo episode, I recap all of it, from the “not-a-mused” zero-day, to the company’s former security chief calling it “totally insane” to trust AI agents with your passwords and finances, to this week’s Reuters report on Meta’s own employees raising alarms.

Security Bite is 9to5Mac’s weekly deep dive into the world of Apple security. Each week, Arin Waichulis unpacks new threats, privacy concerns, vulnerabilities, and more, shaping an ecosystem of over 2 billion devices. Every other week on the Security Bite Podcast, he sits down with experts in the field to break down the most pressing topics.
